title: C/Zephyr: link replay table keyed by pubkey only - no key-generation component or retirement invalidation
description:
Req R-02-054 (spec/02-physical-link.md 4.4, MUST): 'The replay key is (SignerPublicKey, KeyGeneration). An IID, short address, SIID hint, IPv6 source address, interface identifier, or caller-supplied peer label MUST NOT replace either component.'
Req R-02-055 (MUST): retirement of a generation 'MUST immediately make all frames and replay state from that generation unusable.'
Req R-02-060 (MUST): key rotation MAY start a fresh counter only after the new generation is durably installed and the old durably retired; clearing an address alias MUST NOT resurrect the retired generation.

Classification: implemented+tested in Rust and Python; divergent (partial) in C.
Evidence: C lichen/subsys/lichen/link/replay.c:88-123 matches full public_key only; no generation field; no retirement invalidation in the C replay path. lichen_replay_remove is atomic through the durable backend (replay_persist.c:319-355) but cannot distinguish generations.
Conformant: Rust evidence.rs:27-46 PeerKeyGeneration/DurablePeerKeyGeneration, link_layer.rs:400,690-704,1226-1235, tests link_layer.rs:1993,2071-2072 (same-key reinstall gets NEW durable generation); python link_layer.py:1689-1714, replay.py:647-688, tombstones test test_link_security_persistence.py:228.

Suggested placement: add generation identifier to lichen/subsys/lichen/link/replay.c table + replay_persist.c blob (bind under the existing keyed BLAKE2b); wire retirement on key change/unpin. Related: worker6-l1qw.3.7.6.1 (SCHC peer table generation).
